description:
Hello. Weâre Polaroid. An iconic brand, built by passionate people

Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th centuryâs most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: âDonât undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.â

In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today.

At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world.

The Role

As the Country Manager, Canada - you will play a pivotal role in managing and expanding our footprint with National Retailers and Independents alike. We are looking for an experienced account manager that has excellent business and execution skills to deliver profitable customer plans and market share growth. In addition to channel and operational management responsibilities, this role will also collaborate with internal stakeholders from sales operations, finance, demand planning, product management, and marketing.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Canada Market Leadership: Serve as the commercial lead for Polaroid in Canada, owning the Canadian wholesale plan and accountability for revenue and market growth. Be the in-market face of the business and the primary point of leadership for the Canadian commercial team and stakeholders.

  • National Account Ownership: Act as the strategic lead for all national wholesale accounts, ensuring long-term scalability, commercial profitability, and a premium Polaroid brand presence across every brick-and-mortar and digital retail touchpoint.

  • Account Partnership: Build and hold trusted relationships with the most senior buyers, merchants, and decision-makers across national accounts. Lead joint business planning and negotiate mutually beneficial terms that create sustainable, multi-year growth.

  • Team & Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and coordinate the Canadian commercial plan, including setting priorities and coaching supporting team members. Partner closely with US-based planning, finance, retail marketing, and product teams.

  • Forecasting, Demand Planning & SKU Transition: Translate market data into actionable inventory strategies. title: Principal Product Manager Strategic Initiatives
description:
OUR MISSION

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to set the product direction for new, zero-to-one initiatives focused on applying AI to make better care decisions in oncology â helping people receive the right, evidence-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.

This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for a product leader who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels â moving fluidly between learning from users, defining product direction, partnering with engineering and other stakeholders to shape solutions , and driving execution to launch. You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.

Additionally, you will:

  • Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

  • Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally

  • Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations

  • Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders

  • Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations

  • Communicate tradeoffs and profess clearly to senior clinical, engineering, and business stakeholders

  • Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently

WHAT YOU'VE DONE

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including leading zero-to-one or early-stage initiatives when the problem, requirements, and path forward were not fully defined

  • You have healthcare experience, ideally building workflow, data, or integration products for enterprise contexts

  • Youâre comfortable with ambiguity and defining a path forward for yourself and others

  • You have hands-on experience building or shipping AI/LLM-powered products

  • You communicate clearly and build alignment across engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders

  • You like to operate close to the technical details, such as data models, edge cases, evaluations, and impacts of implementation

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management

  • Hands-on experience shipping AI/LLM-powered product features, including safety guardrails, evaluation, and quality measurement

OUR VALUES

At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we chooseâor donât choose.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $195,500-$230,000. The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level. This position is also bonus-eligible.

We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. Weâre here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

  • Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

  • Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

  • Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

  • Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

  • Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

  • Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

  • Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

  • Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

  • Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

  • Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

  • Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

  • Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)

  • Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

  • Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

  • Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

  • Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

  • 3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)

This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support.   • Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law.

  • Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together.

  • Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns.

  • Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track.

  • Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas.

Academic Data & Testing Coordination

  • Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions.

  • Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing.

  • Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

  • Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families.

  • Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities.

  • Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations.

  • Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments.

  • Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices.

  • Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers

  • Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate

  • A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny

  • A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability

  • Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions

  • Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities

  • Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment

  • Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback

Why Join Us?

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.



Mandatory:

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

Preferred:

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n

  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.

Experience:

  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.

Platform QA Chapter Lead (all genders)
description:
As Platform QA Chapter Lead on the Platform side at JustPlay, you’ll lead and scale quality assurance for our core app experience - the foundation that powers our games, live operations, and player rewards. Working closely with Engineering, you’ll ensure the platform runs seamlessly across devices, regions, and releases, setting the standard for quality, reliability, and user experience.

You'll split your time between hands-on QA work and leading the QA engineers in the QA chapter: helping them grow in their craft, spreading good practice, and raising the bar for quality across the teams you work with. A key part of this role will be driving smarter, more scalable testing approaches, including AI-driven testing and automation.

 
 

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the full QA lifecycle for JustPlay’s app and platform features - from test planning and execution to reporting and defect management.

  • Foster a strong quality culture across teams by embedding QA best practices early and tying quality goals to product velocity and platform reliability.

  • Drive innovation through AI-driven testing and predictive approaches to identify risks earlier, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort.

  • Partner with development, design, and product teams to integrate QA best practices early in the release cycle.

  • Design and maintain comprehensive test plans and automated suites for key user flows (login, payments, live events, notifications, etc.).

  • Lead, mentor, and scale the QA team - setting up clear processes, code quality standards, and testing frameworks.

  • Implement automation and regression testing strategies using tools such as Maestro, Espresso, XCTest, Appium, or similar frameworks.

  • Use contract testing (e.g., Pact) to validate backend and service integrations.

  • Apply performance and reliability testing across mobile platforms to ensure smooth user experiences.

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in QA for mobile apps or platforms, including at least 2 years leading teams.

  • Proven ability to design scalable QA processes in fast-paced, development-heavy environments.

  • Strong experience with automation frameworks, regression testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with mobile debugging tools (Android Studio, Xcode) and network analysis tools like Charles.

  • Strong understanding of how to build a quality-first mindset across engineering and product teams.

  • Interest in or experience with AI-assisted testing and new QA technologies.

  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-first mindset.

  • Familiarity with project and documentation tools such as Jira and Notion.

Nice to have

  • Experience in backend integration testing and API monitoring.

  • Experience with contract testing frameworks such as Pact.

Job Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

 

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. We know great candidates don’t always tick every box and some of our best hires didn't either. We are looking forward to your application!

title: Inside Sales Manager
description:
Inside Sales Manager (m/w/d) – Nachunternehmer

Du hast Biss, Hunger auf Erfolg und willst Deals closen, statt nur über Leads zu reden? Dann ist das hier dein Spielfeld.

Cosuno ist die größte Plattform, auf der Auftraggeber im Bau ihre Projekte ausschreiben und Handwerksbetriebe neue Aufträge finden. Der Nachunternehmer-Bereich ist unser am schnellsten wachsender Bereich, und 2027 wollen wir den Umsatz verdoppeln. Dafür suchen wir Closer, keine Verwalter.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Full Cycle: vom ersten Call über die Demo bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag

  • Warme Leads statt Kaltakquise: Du rufst Handwerksbetriebe an, die bereits auf Cosuno registriert sind.

  • Direkt mit Entscheidern: Am Telefon hast du Inhaber und Geschäftsführer, keine Einkaufsabteilungen. Das heißt kurze Entscheidungswege und schnelle Abschlüsse.

  • Demos & Verhandlung: Du zeigst Betrieben, welche Aufträge auf sie warten, und bringst den Deal über die Ziellinie.

  • Pipeline: Du hältst deine Opportunities in Salesforce sauber und auf Closing-Kurs.

Dein Setup

  • Jeden Morgen schlägt dir die KI deine besten Leads vor.

  • Nach der Demo erstellt die KI eine persönliche Potenzialanalyse für deinen Kunden.

  • Was kein Gespräch ist, automatisieren wir laufend. Deine Zeit steckst du in Calls, Demos und Abschlüsse.

  • Was dich schneller macht, bauen wir mit dir ein. Deine Ideen zählen.

Woran wir dich messen

  • Umsatz gegen dein Monatsziel – das ist die Zahl, die zählt.

  • Aktivität und Qualität: Calls, Demos, Conversion

  • Entwicklung: wie schnell du Feedback umsetzt und dich anpasst

  • Team: was du teilst und wie du andere besser machst

Das alles siehst du transparent im täglichen Team-Ranking.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Vertrieb, idealerweise B2B und Full Cycle

  • Du kannst belegen, dass du deine Ziele konstant übertriffst, also über 100 %.

  • Closing-Mindset: Für dich zählt der Abschluss, nicht der Prozess.

  • Du überzeugst am Telefon, per Mail und in der Demo.

  • Du nutzt AI-Tools selbstverständlich, verstehst Prozesse und hast Lust, sie mit zu automatisieren.

  • Du lernst schnell, nimmst Feedback an und willst jeden Monat besser werden.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C2); Englisch ist ein Plus.

Was wir bieten

  • Fixum plus ungedeckelte Provision, jeden Monat ausgezahlt (optional: sechsstellig bei Zielerreichung)

  • Ein klarer Karrierepfad: vom Inside Sales Manager über Senior bis zum Account Executive oder Teamlead, mit Fast Track für Overperformer

  • Onboarding und Coaching durch die Top-Performer im Team

  • Ein ambitioniertes Team in einem Markt, der gerade erst digital wird

Warum wir?

  • Gestalte ein Produkt mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Probleme in einer der größten Industrien Europas – der Bauwirtschaft.

  • Performance-Kultur: Ungedeckelte Provision, transparente Regeln und 100 % Eigenverantwortung für deinen Erfolg.

  • Flexibilität: Arbeite remote oder in unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain.

  • Team-Spirit: Internationales, dynamisches Team mit flachen Hierarchien und echtem Zusammenhalt.

  • Wachstum: Regelmäßiges Feedback, 1:1s und Entwicklungsgespräche – wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickelst.

  • Erfolge feiern: Ob Firmenevents oder Teamevents – wir gewinnen und feiern gemeinsam.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Why Cosuno?

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Operate, monitor and maintain our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum) across servers, operator stations and displays

  • Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure

  • Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators

  • Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation

  • Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen

  • Add new datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and tune alarms so operators trust the system

  • Keep documentation current - as-built drawings, tag lists, change records - and uphold change control

  • Act as the technical counterpart to contractors and vendors, and support qualification and audits with system evidence

Your Qualifications

  • One of two equivalent qualification paths: a completed apprenticeship as an Electronics Technician for Automation Technology plus further training as a state-certified technician (Techniker), or comparable - or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering or a related field, or comparable

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with industrial SCADA and PLC systems in a production environment - commissioning, operating or supporting, not only design

  • Solid experience with Siemens S7 PLCs (TIA Portal / Step 7) - going online, reading and modifying logic, diagnosing faults on a running plant; experience with comparable PLC platforms is also welcome

  • Strong SCADA engineering skills - ideally Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum, but experience with another platform (e.g. WinCC, PCS 7, Ignition, Aveva, Zenon) plus the willingness to grow into WinCC OA is just as welcome

  • Practical experience with loop checks, instrument calibration and signal troubleshooting, and with reading P&IDs, loop diagrams and I/O lists

  • A structured, disciplined approach to documentation and change control, and the confidence to say no to a change that compromises safety or system integrity

  • Good command of English; German is a strong advantage given the site, suppliers and local contractors

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Entwicklungsingenieur Konstruktion (m/w/d)
description:
Das ist Dein Aufgabengebiet

Mit Deiner Konstruktionserfahrung wirkst Du an der Entwicklung sicherer und innovativer Endoprothesen mit und begleitest sie über den gesamten Entwicklungsprozess – von der Idee bis zur Serienreife – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams und externen Partnern.

  • Du entwickelst und konstruierst unsere Produkte und übernimmst dabei sämtliche Schritte im definierten, strukturierten Entwicklungsprozess – von der Idee bis zum serienreifen Produkt
  • Du erstellst und pflegst technische Zeichnungen, 3D-Modelle und Konstruktionsunterlagen und stellst sicher, dass diese den relevanten Normen entsprechen
  • Du wirkst maßgeblich an mechanischen Designs, Prototypen, Funktionsmustern sowie an Validierungs- und Verifizierungsprozessen mit
  • Du führst Konstruktionsänderungen durch, bewertest technische Anforderungen und begleitest Tests, Prüfungen und Verbesserungsmaßnahmen
  • Du erstellst technische Dokumentationen und wirkst an der Umsetzung zulassungsrelevanter Anforderungen (u. a. CE, harmonisierte Normen, (EU) 2017/745 bzw. MDR) mit
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Ärzten, Produktmanagement, Produktion und Qualitätsmanagement zusammen und übernimmst die kommunikative Schnittstellenfunktion in internationalen Entwicklungsprojekten

Das bringst Du mit

Ausbildung

  • Abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Medizintechnik) oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang

Berufserfahrung

  • Fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Konstruktion und Entwicklung technischer Produkte mit Schwerpunkt auf der Implantat‑ und/oder Instrumentenentwicklung in der Medizintechnik

Fachwissen

  • Sehr gute 3D‑CAD‑Kenntnisse aus der praktischen Anwendung, insbesondere mit Siemens NX
  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit PLM‑Systemen (z. B. Teamcenter)
  • Kenntnisse in Biomechanik sowie entsprechende Produktkenntnisse im Bereich Endoprothetik von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung in der Mitarbeit an Entwicklungsprojekten wünschenswert
  • Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in der Anwendung von Normen der geometrischen Produktspezifikation (z.B. ISO 1101)

Arbeitsweise & Motivation

  • Du verfügst über eine offene und klare Kommunikationsweise, arbeitest gerne in interdisziplinären Teams und beherrschst Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift sowie Englisch auf gutem Niveau
  • Du möchtest fachlich tief eintauchen und Zusammenhänge sowie Wechselwirkungen verstehen, um dieses Wissen gezielt in Deine Arbeit einfließen zu lassen
  • Du behältst Deine Aufgaben und Projekte im Blick und kannst jederzeit ein Status‑Update geben Diese Position setzt Erfahrung in der Entwicklung regulierter Medizinprodukte voraus. Wenn Du Dich hier wiederfindest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

Das kannst Du von uns erwarten

  • Zukunftsbranche: Du erhältst einen unbefristeten Arbeitsplatz in der Medizintechnik
  • Miteinander: Gemeinsam für innovative Medizintechnik
  • Onboarding: Du startest mit einer intensiven und strukturierten Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Teammitglieder sowie durch unsere Veranstaltungen BE Link und Hey LINK
  • Work-Life-Balance: 37,5 Wochenstunden | 30 Tage Urlaub | mobiles Arbeiten
  • Zukunft? Gesichert!: Wir sorgen zusammen für Deine Zukunft z.B. mit einer betriebliche Altersvorsorge inkl. Arbeitgeberzuschuss
  • C orporate B enefits : Nutze zahlreiche Mitarbeitenden-Rabatte bei zahlreichen Kooperationspartnern
  • Mobilität: 25% Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket | kostenlose Parkplätze | überdachter Fahrradparkplatz | Bikeleasing
  • Umzugsstress?: Nicht mit uns - nach Absprache übernehmen wir gern die Kosten Deines Umzugs mit einer steuerfreien Umzugspauschale bis zu einer Höhe von 964€
  • Vergütung: Empfehlungsbonus für neu geworbene Mitarbeitende
  • Bewegung: Betriebssportprogramme | gemeinsame Sportevents

Unsere Stellenausschreibung gibt Dir einen Einblick in die Anforderungen der Position. Falls Du nicht alle Anforderungen mitbringst, kein Problem. Für uns zählst Du als Mensch und Deine Motivation.

Wenn Du Dich von dieser Position angesprochen fühlst und bereit bist, Teil unseres engagierten Teams zu werden, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

WALDEMAR LINK GmbH & Co. KG
Human Resources
David Bahner

title: Embedded Systems Engineer
description:
The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Systems Engineer to develop the board management infrastructure for Openchip's next-generation data center accelerator platforms.

In this role, you will own the complete board management solution from hardware definition and MCU integration through firmware development, bring-up, validation, and deployment. Your work will enable silicon bring-up, hardware validation, remote access, observability, and platform automation for our validation platforms and production systems.

You will work across hardware and software domains, collaborating closely with silicon, hardware, validation, firmware, and system teams to ensure our in-house accelerator silicon can be brought up, debugged, validated, and accessed efficiently.

This is a hands-on role combining embedded development, hardware integration, laboratory debugging, and technical leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

· Define and implement board management architectures for validation platforms, debug boards, and accelerator cards.

· Evaluate, select, and integrate MCUs, management controllers, sensors, and supporting hardware components.

· Develop firmware and software for power sequencing, telemetry, monitoring, voltage margining, reset control, and platform automation.

· Evaluate, customize, and integrate technologies such as OpenBMC and other open-source management frameworks.

· Enable remote platform access, recovery, and management capabilities for engineering teams.

· Collaborate with hardware teams on schematic reviews, hardware integration, and bring-up requirements.

· Create tools, scripts, and automation to improve validation efficiency and engineering productivity.

· Support first-silicon bring-up, board debugging, and platform validation activities.

· Debug hardware and firmware interactions using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other laboratory equipment.

· Support manufacturing test, firmware provisioning, and lifecycle management processes.

· Drive technical execution across multiple projects while contributing to architecture, risk reduction, and long-term platform strategy.

· Generate design documentation, validation procedures, and engineering guidelines.

Minimum Qualifications:

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field.

· 5+ years of experience developing embedded firmware and software.

· Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ development.

· Solid understanding of digital hardware design and board-level electronics.

· Experience reading and reviewing schematics, PCB layouts, datasheets, and hardware interface specifications.

· Familiarity with I2C/SMBus, SPI, UART, GPIO, JTAG, and other common embedded interfaces.

· Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related laboratory equipment.

· Experience with Linux-based development environments.

· Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualificacions:

· Experience with OpenBMC, embedded Linux, Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or similar platforms.

· Experience developing board management controllers, service processors, or platform management solutions.

· Experience supporting silicon bring-up, board bring-up, or hardware validation programs.

· Familiarity with data center, server, networking, accelerator, or HPC hardware.

· Understanding of power sequencing, PMBus, telemetry, monitoring, and voltage margining concepts.

· Familiarity with PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and other high-speed platform interfaces.

· Experience developing automation tools using Python or similar scripting languages.

· Exposure to manufacturing test, production provisioning, and deployment workflows.

· Knowledge of secure boot, firmware update mechanisms, and remote-management architectures.

Soft skills:

· A systems-level mindset spanning both hardware and software.

· Strong technical curiosity and a hands-on approach to engineering challenges.

· The ability to work effectively across multiple technical disciplines.

· Sound engineering judgment and a pragmatic approach to problem solving.

· Ownership and accountability for delivering robust platform management solutions that enable successful silicon bring-up and platform validation.

What We Offer?

· A chance to work at one of the most transformative AI and silicon engineering companies in Europe with cutting-edge technology and industry leaders

· We offer a remuneration package that values your experience

· We believe in investing in our employees and providing them with opportunities for growth and career development

· Join an innovative team and experience company growth

· Travel within Europe, with occasional travel to Asia, to work with our teams and partners

We are looking for outstanding people willing to join our mission to change the silicon industry and help build a better world. If you identify with Openchip, please contact us.

At Openchip, we believe a diverse and inclusive team is the key to groundbreaking ideas. We foster a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential—regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a motivated and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join our Team Greenrock – Demand Division. 

Our Tech team owns Flix's Revenue Management System (RMS), a production system with a direct commercial impact. We are looking for a colleague who will play an active role in shaping the next generation of the RMS by leveraging their deep expertise in revenue management. 

This is a hands-on senior role in a non-greenfield environment: delivering meaningful change requires care, conviction, and patience. 

About the Role

  • Work closely with commercial stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped projects and respond to operational inquiries.
  • Translate revenue management theory and industry best practices into concrete, testable improvements, from idea and experimentation through to production rollout.
  • Co-own the evolution of the entire system through regular collaboration and discussions with peers across your team and neighboring engineering teams.
  • Contribute to the technical health, reliability, and observability of the existing system. 

About You

Education and Revenue Management expertise (must-have)

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
  • Solid theoretical foundation in RM: demand modeling, dynamic pricing, and network revenue management.
  • Applied experience with RM or pricing tech solutions in transportation, travel, hospitality, retail, or a comparable domain is a big plus. 

Engineering and data craft 

  • Strong hands-on Python (including NumPy, Polars, Pandas, SciPy) and comfort with SQL on large datasets.
  • Production-code experience is welcome but not required; what we expect is genuine interest in writing, reviewing, and maintaining code that runs reliably in production. 

Soft skills 

  • Excellent communication: you explain complex quantitative concepts or optimisation trade-offs to technical and non-technical, commercial audiences alike, and you enjoy educating and advocating for sound RM solutions.
  • Senior judgment: you scope your own work, balance short-term fixes with long-term direction, and respect the constraints of an existing system. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Venture Development
description:
About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

  • 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

  • ~110 people on the team in Munich

  • €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You build the teams that build Tacto, working directly with our CEO and Chief of Staff.

Why this role exists

We are entering our next growth phase in the AGI age: new markets, new teams and the structures that carry them. Almost all of it runs through people: who we hire, how we set up teams and the culture of ambition we protect. As a Venture Developer, you own several hiring pipelines across functions, from Sales to Tech to Customer Value, and you help make Tacto the place where the best talent in Europe wants to work. Our own AI agents do much of the searching and first outreach, so about half of your week goes to what only people get to do: speaking to talent, judging fit and giving every candidate a great experience. You work directly with André (CEO) and Marla (Chief of Staff).

Why your role matters

  • You decide who gets in. You run the first interviews and shape which candidates our hiring managers meet. Every person you move forward can shape a team at Tacto for years. Talent is our biggest lever in building a generational company.

  • You see every part of the company. You interact with Sales, Tech and Customer Value roles and learn fast what great looks like in each.

  • AI does the groundwork, you bring the judgement. Our agents search, score and write to candidates. You decide where they look, check what they find and raise their bar.

  • You grow as fast as you deliver. 70%+ of our leadership team was promoted internally. After your first year, you shape your own path: in Talent, Ops, Tech or in a commercial role.

What your week looks like

  • Interviews: about 40%

  • Steering and reviewing sourcing: about 20%

  • Candidate communication and scheduling: about 10%

  • Events, campaigns, merch and employer branding: about 20%

  • Other: about 10%

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: The first 9 to 12 months are about execution: many interviews and candidate calls, clean pipelines and events that run smoothly. It's not always glamorous, but some of the highest leverage work at Tacto and that's how we like it.

  • Not a closing role: Offers and final negotiations sit with our Chief of Staff and the hiring managers. Your job is to bring the right people to the final round, with a clear picture of who they are and making sure that everybody is aligned to provide the best possible candidate experience we can.

  • Not a strategy role: Those don’t exist at Tacto. It is also not a short stop: we look for people who want to grow here. Where you want to grow and into which direction you want to take your career is up to you to define.

  • The deal: Prove yourself with real impact, and we back your growth in every way we can.

Your tasks

  • Own your pipelines and build the org: You own a few open roles at a time, often in very different teams. You agree with each hiring manager on who we are looking for and keep the pipeline moving until the final interview.

  • Interview and assess: You run first interviews, judge fit against a clear bar and give hiring managers a sharp recommendation.

  • Orchestrate sourcing: Our AI skills search, score and write to candidates. You decide where they look, review what they find and source yourself where it counts.

  • Turn candidates into fans: You make our process fast, personal and honest, from the first message to the final interview. Even the people we say no to should walk away telling their friends to apply.

  • Build a base that scales: You set up job descriptions, interview plans, pipelines and data that let us grow the team without losing speed or quality. What you build today is how Tacto hires tomorrow.

  • Shape how Tacto shows up: You help run our talent events, from hackathons and university partnerships to invite-only dinners and Lunch & Learns, plus campaigns, merch and employer branding.

  • Grow into company building: Once the basics run, you take on additional projects with our Chief of Staff. Your path is yours to define in this role and you will receive all the support needed to make it happen.

Your profile

Experience and skills

  • Experience: Ideally 1 to 2 years of work experience, but not required

  • High bar: You’ve seen what great looks like, through an internship or role at a top startup, in consulting or in VC

  • AI native: You already use AI in your daily work and want to build with it, not just use it

  • Languages: Fluent German and English

Core strengths

  • People intuition: You read people fast, connect easily and build trust

  • Storyteller: You sell a vision and get others excited to join it

  • Hands on: You solve problems yourself instead of only talking about them

  • Hungry and fast: You get energy from moving fast and seeing results

  • Curious about company building: You want to understand how companies grow and can see yourself in Talent or org building long term

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events, for example with Andreas Klinger, Judith Dada or at large hackathons. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • €1,500+ learning budget per year

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

  • Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro Call, 20 min, with the People Team

  2. Hiring Manager Interview, 30 min, with Marla (Chief of Staff)

  3. Mini Task, 30 min prep + 30 min call, with Marla

  4. Onsite Case and Meet the Team, 4-5h prep + 1.5h at our office, with Marla, André, and two people from the team

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. About the Role

As an Information Security Officer, you will advise clients on the strategic and operational development of their information security programs. You will work with management and specialist teams to address regulatory requirements and build sustainable governance structures across a range of industries.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as an external Information Security Officer for clients, supporting the ongoing development of their information security programs.

  • Advise business teams and senior leaders on requirements including NIS2, DORA, CRA, ISO 27001, and IEC 62443.

  • Conduct risk analyses, gap analyses, and maturity assessments, then develop practical recommendations.

  • Support the setup, development, and operation of information security management systems.

  • Plan and facilitate workshops, status meetings, steering committees, cyber incident simulations, and tabletop exercises.

  • Help clients establish and improve governance, risk, and compliance processes.

  • Develop reusable approaches, templates, documentation, and tools for client projects.

  • Contribute expertise to new services and proposals, and support technical presentations, webinars, and written content.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in information security, GRC, ISMS, or cybersecurity consulting.

  • Experience as an Information Security Officer, Security Consultant, or in a comparable role.

  • Practical experience with risk analyses, gap analyses, and security assessments, as well as setting up or operating an ISMS.

  • Knowledge of standards and regulations such as ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, CRA, or IEC 62443.

  • Experience facilitating workshops or security exercises and communicating complex topics to management and C-level audiences.

  • Structured, independent, solutions-oriented working style and a strong understanding of business processes.

  • German proficiency at C1 level and English proficiency at B2 level.

Compensation & Benefits

Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Location

Hybrid role based in Cologne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA
description:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have...

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get

- Competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity

- Remote in EMEA, with hubs in New York, Toronto and Barcelona

- Direct access to leadership and a real say in how we sell to enterprise

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation including equity package

  • Competitive vacation policy

  • Medical Insurance

  • L&D budget

  • Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

  • Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: Our purpose is to create value for the finance teams we serve. We pour our energy into driving impact for them fast, and we measure our success by theirs.

Relentless Ambition: We chose to compete at the top alongside the best. We set ambitious goals, and keep pushing when it gets hard. Nothing worth having comes easy.

One Team: There is no “they” at Abacum: “their” problem is our problem. We’re candid because we care, we help each other grow, and we embrace different perspectives.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
