title: Technical Account Manager
Senior People Ops Manager (International)
description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading AI photo and video solution for e-commerce, helping businesses sell at first sight.

Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

 

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

 
 

What you will own

 

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

 

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

 

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

 

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

 

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

 

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

 

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

 
 

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

 

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

 

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Technical Marketing Manager
description:
As an individual contributor sitting at the intersection of engineering and business, you turn complex memory technology and system concepts into accurate, accessible, and compelling technical content. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams, as well as memory design and strategic partnership teams, you gather validated information to create key materials, including product and specification documents in line with system architects and product managers, datasheets, reference manuals, whitepapers, application notes, technical blogs, and technical presentation decks.

In addition to technical content creation, you will participate in customer first technical meetings to present and support the specifications and technical claims before highly technical audiences. 

Reporting to Vertical Compute’s Product Marketing Lead, this is a hands-on individual-contributor role with a direct impact on how our technology is understood and brought to market.

Technical writing/content development  |  primary focus

  • Write technical documentation (product, specifications..), customer-facing datasheets, reference manuals.

  • Create, edit and maintain technical blogs, in-depth whitepapers, application notes, product/technology briefs, FAQs and other long-form technical content.

  • Develop customer-facing datasheets and specification documents based on requirements and parameters defined and approved by Product/Engineering.

  • Create architecture diagrams, explanatory visuals, technical slide content and compelling material for conference talks, abstracts and presentations.

  • Adapt approved technical information for audiences ranging from semiconductor specialists to system architects, partners and technically minded business stakeholders.

  • Create and coordinate high-quality technical content: website copy, product pages, whitepapers, presentations, and conference materials

Interface with Product, Architecture & Engineering

  • Work closely with the Product/Architecture team and relevant engineering experts to gather information about functionality, use cases, performance, power, bandwidth, integration and system-level trade-offs.

  • Ask probing technical questions, distinguish demonstrated results from targets, and turn source material into precise, readable drafts.

  • Coordinate technical review and approval with the relevant subject-matter owners and marketing lead before external release; maintain the traceability and versioning of technical claims.

Technical marketing & enablement

  • Participate in first-level customer technical meetings to present and support technical specifications, architecture choices, and performance/power/bandwidth trade-offs to system architects.

  • Support early customer engagements with tailored messaging and technical storytelling

  • Produce technically sound product and competitive comparisons that support the positioning and priorities defined by the Marketing Lead.

  • Develop technical content for product pages, demonstrations, customer briefings, partner presentations and Business Development enablement.

  • Support agreed conference submissions and product milestones with the technical material needed by speakers and customer-facing teams.

  • Support presence at industry events, conferences, and partner demos

Content execution & quality

  • Own timelines, drafts, review loops, version control and delivery for assigned content; flag missing inputs and risks early.

  • Maintain a curated, approved repository of technical facts, diagrams, reusable explanations and reference materials.

  • Demonstrate adaptability to a fast-moving startup environment and evolving targets.


Training background :  Degree in electronics, microelectronics, computer engineering, computer science or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience is also welcome.

Relevant experience:   Practical experience in technical writing, technical marketing, applications engineering, product engineering, or another engineering-facing communication role. Suitable seniority may range from an emerging independent contributor to an experienced specialist.

Technical / industry knowledge:  Solid understanding of semiconductor hardware and system concepts; familiarity with memory architectures, SoCs, AI accelerators, advanced packaging or compute infrastructure is strongly valued. Ability to understand performance/power/bandwidth trade-offs and data from technical experts is essential.

Writing / communication: Excellent written and spoken English; ability to communicate effectively in meetings, structure detailed technical arguments, edit precisely, and tailor content to technical audiences. Evidence of authored documentation or published technical content is a strong plus.

Design & Visual Content Independence: Must be capable of creating compelling technical content, diagrams, and visual assets independently (e.g. Powerpoint, Google slides, Canva, Gimp..) without relying on external agencies, and should be well-versed with office productivity tools and presentation software.

Interpersonal skills and ways of working:  Curious, rigorous, comfortable challenging ambiguous input; proactive in working with engineers; strong prioritization, commitment to deadlines and careful technical-review discipline.


Other considerations:  Portfolio or writing samples preferred. You should be able to write strong first drafts independently, while keeping in mind that final product definitions and external claims are handled by the product and marketing leads.

Generative AI Tools: Familiarity with generative AI tools and workflows to enhance content creation productivity and efficiency.

title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] – Data Intelligence Platform
description:
About Actian

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.

 


What You Will Own:

1. Platform Engineering & Architecture

  • Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
  • Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

    • 2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
  • Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
  • Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
  • Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

    • 3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

  • Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.
  • Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.
  • Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.
  • Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.
  • Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.
  • Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

    • 4. Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
  • Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.
  • Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.
  • Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

    • 5. Team Building & Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.
  • Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.
  • Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.
  • Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

    • What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:
  • Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.
  • Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.
  • Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.
  • Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.
  • Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.
  • Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

    • What You Bring:

    Leadership & Experience

  • 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.
  • At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.
  • Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.
  • A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.
  • The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

    • Technical Expertise

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.
  • Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.
  • Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
  • Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
  • Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

    • AI-First Mindset

  • Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.
  • Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.
  • Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.
  • A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

    • Leadership Approach

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.
  • Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes.
  • Able to build teams and systems from scratch.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams.
  • Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones.

    • Nice to Have:
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, data catalogues, metadata management, or graph databases.
  • Production experience across multiple cloud providers.
  • Experience with air-gapped and restricted-network deployments.
  • Infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, model serving, vector databases, or graph data stores.
  • OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies.
  • Privileged access management solutions such as StrongDM.

    • How You Will Work:

    You will report directly to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Customer Success, and Support.

    This is a fully remote position based in the US East Coast, UK, Germany, France, or Spain, subject to local employment eligibility.

    You should be able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time.

    Occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings may be required.

    We value builders over theorists, ownership over hierarchy, and measurable outcomes over activity.

    If you have built and scaled a platform engineering organisation, remain technically hands-on, and believe AI should fundamentally change how infrastructure teams operate, we would like to hear from you.


    What We Offer:
  • The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
  • Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

DiliTrust’s R&D organization is undergoing a deep transformation toward AI-driven engineering across every role, from Product and QA to DevOps, Engineering and Architecture. Identify overlaps, gaps and inconsistencies, and clarify shared concepts such as users, entities, documents, workflows, permissions and audit trails.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, Engineering Managers, QA and technical architects to resolve functional inconsistencies and ensure that product and engineering decisions remain coherent across the platform. 

  • Coach teams and champion functional practices: Act as a reference on functional topics, onboarding and coaching teams on the domain model, design standards and ways of working.

description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.

These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control

  • Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment.

  • Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines.

  • Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

  • Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions.

  • Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements

  • Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus.

  • Technical skills: Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus.

  • Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

 

Responsibilities

  • Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

  • MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

  • Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

  • BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

  • High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

  • EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

  • Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

  • Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

  • Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

  • Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics.

  • Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design: gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets.

  • Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification): ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms.

  • Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium).

  • Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug.

  • Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed.

  • Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership.

  • English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

Technical Marketing Engineer
description:
The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Senior Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description

Sonar is becoming an AI-first company. Strategy Enablement turns Sonar's strategic ideas into real, lasting results: company-critical initiatives, business transformations, acquisition integrations and new market expansion. As Sr. Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives, you will lead some of these initiatives from fuzzy intent to measurable outcome with pace and focus, as a trusted thought partner to leadership. Everything we do ultimately serves our internal and external customers, and you will keep them at the center of the solutions you design. You will reinvent both how projects are run and what they deliver: you use AI agents every day in your own work, and you design solutions AI-first, ambitious yet practical. Your first focus will be the AI transformation of our Go-To-Market organization, with our Business Technology team (including SALT, its AI team) and the Data & Insights team. Over time, you will lead initiatives across the company, in domains you may not know yet.

What you will do

  • Frame ambiguous strategic intents into clear problems, objectives and business cases, starting from the impact on our customers and the business.

  • Bring the customer voice into every initiative: use customer feedback and data to shape solutions, and make sure internal changes improve how customers buy, use and renew with Sonar.

  • Ground decisions in data: establish baselines, size opportunities, define success metrics up front and measure impact after go-live.

  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives end to end, driving pace and keeping the focus on customer and business outcomes.

  • Re-plan quickly when priorities or context change, and recommend stopping work that no longer pays off.

  • Redesign processes AI-first, from the outcome back: decide what AI agents do, where humans and AI work together and where human judgment stays essential, with guardrails proportional to business risk.

  • Build working prototypes (skills, agents, lightweight apps, automations) to test ideas early with users, then partner with Business Technology to industrialize what works.

  • Use AI agents systematically in your own business analysis and project management work, and share reusable skills and workflows to raise the AI bar around you.

  • Bridge leadership and operational teams: engage stakeholders early, manage competing priorities and keep sponsors and teams aligned.

  • Stay agile and pragmatic: run initiatives with simple, effective tools and communication rather than heavy process and admin, pick the approach that drives the behaviors and actions needed, re-plan quickly when context changes, and recommend stopping work that no longer pays off.

  • Master business analysis and project management foundations, and apply them pragmatically: just enough process, simple tools and clear communication, never process for its own sake.

  • Own change management as part of delivery (communication, training, champions, reinforcement) until new ways of working stick, with particular care for the human side of AI-driven change.

Experience and qualifications

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have 10+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional, international transformation or strategic initiatives, ideally combining strategy or transformation consulting with in-house experience in a fast-growing tech or SaaS company.

  • Bring a proven track record of measurable outcomes (revenue, cost, efficiency, adoption, customer experience), not just projects delivered.

  • Have a strong customer mindset: see internal work as a way to serve customers, and use that lens to set priorities.

  • Use AI agents and assistants (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) hands-on every day, with concrete examples of skills, agents or workflows they have built.

  • Have designed or delivered AI-enabled processes, with a pragmatic view of AI's value, limits and risks.

  • Be strongly data-driven: analyze business data themselves (spreadsheets, SQL or BI tools, AI-assisted analysis) to build business cases and track results.

  • Demonstrate strong change management, stakeholder management and communication skills, having led people through significant change and influenced executives and operational teams alike.

  • Master business analysis and project management foundations, and apply them flexibly rather than by the book.

  • Thrive in ambiguity: decide with partial information and adapt the plan without losing sight of the goal.

  • Show strong curiosity and learn new domains quickly. Go-To-Market experience is a plus.

  • Be fluent in English, written and spoken. French is a plus.

description:
We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. What you can expect

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our ClearBank Europe’s Operations team as a Senior Credit & Risk Associate?

Reporting directly to the Director of Operations, you will be at the centre of the day-to-day credit lifecycle. You will own and execute the core credit assessment, monitoring and provisioning activities that support sound lending decisions, and you will coordinate the information and hand-offs required across Sales, Finance & Treasury, and Risk. Alongside this, you will support the management of ClearBank Europe’s operational risk environment, risks and controls, operational risk events, issues and actions, and evidence of control effectiveness across the Operations function. The role in a nutshell: you produce, operate and coordinate the first-line credit process; working closely with second line as they provide independent review and challenge.

Your role includes:

Creditworthiness assessment and underwriting

  • Own the creditworthiness assessment model specifications and the supporting assessment tool, keeping the methodology and practical execution aligned.

  • Execute creditworthiness assessments for onboarding and periodic reviews, including gathering and assessing the required client inputs and translating the outcome into a clear credit conclusion.

  • Prepare the first-line overdraft / credit proposal, inc luding the proposed limit and the analysis supporting the recommendation, and coordinate the proposal through the relevant approval process.

  • Coordinate credit onboarding once approved, ensuring agreed credit terms and the relevant operational hand-offs are clear to the teams involved.

Early warning, portfolio monitoring & provisioning

  • Own and operate the Early Warning Indicator assessment process and investigate triggered cases.

  • Maintain visibility of Watch List and Default cases, ensuring appropriate escalation and hand-off.

  • Produce first-line credit risk monitoring across the portfolio, identifying changes in exposure, concentrations and emerging risks.

  • Coordinate annual credit reviews, renewals and exits.

  • Support NPE and forbearance management through appropriate first-line analysis, case history and supporting data.

Credit risk framework and pricing

  • Maintain the first-line Credit Risk / Credit Underwriting framework and supporting operating procedures.

  • Translate relevant policy requirements into practical processes, tools, controls and monitoring.

  • Coordinate periodic review of relevant interest-rate spreads and overdraft fees with Finance & Treasury.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, consistency and control of the credit process.

Risk & Controls

  • Support the ongoing development of Operations risk and control within ClearBank Europe, ensuring operational risks, controls and residual-risk assessments remain current, appropriately evidenced and aligned to risk appetite.

  • Work with risk and control owners to assess inherent risk, control design and effectiveness, and residual risk, providing constructive first-line challenge where required.

  • Maintain oversight of locally operated, Group and outsourced controls, ensuring ClearBank Europe has appropriate evidence and entity-level oversight.

  • Support the management of operational incidents, control weaknesses, issues and remediation actions, ensuring root causes and lessons learned feed back into the RCSA and control environment.

What does success in this role look like?

  • Credit assessments and proposals are timely, well evidenced and decision-ready, with a clear audit trail from client information through to conclusion and limit recommendation.

  • Daily EWI monitoring and annual reviews operate reliably, with Watch List, Default, renewal and exit cases identified and progressed without unnecessary delay.

  • The first-line credit framework, models and tools remain practical, current and consistently applied as the lending portfolio develops.

  • Stakeholders have a clear view of case status, responsibilities and next steps because you actively coordinate the credit lifecycle rather than simply completing individual analyses.

  • There is clear separation between first-line ownership and second-line independent challenge, while the two roles work together effectively to keep the portfolio within approved risk appetite.

  • Robust, current and well-evidenced operational risk and control environment, proactively identifying emerging risks and control weaknesses and ensuring appropriate actions are taken to address them.

What you’ll bring:

  • Hands-on experience in credit analysis, underwriting, portfolio monitoring or a closely related first-line credit role within banking or regulated financial services.

  • Strong ability to analyse financial and non-financial information and convert it into a concise, evidence-based credit view and recommendation.

  • Working knowledge of business or institutional lending products and the risk drivers associated with limits, overdrafts or comparable credit exposures.

  • Practical understanding of early-warning monitoring, Watch List / Default concepts and the credit lifecycle from onboarding through periodic review, renewal and exit.

  • Working knowledge of IFRS 9 provisioning and staging, with the ability to operate models and investigate or explain outcomes. Model ownership or methodology experience is an advantage.

  • Having some financial crime risk background within a regulated institution is also nice to have.

  • Strong organisation and stakeholder coordination skills. You are comfortable driving inputs and actions across Sales, Operations, Finance & Treasury, Risk and governance forums.

  • A can-do attitude geared to execution, with strong attention to detail and the judgement to know when an issue needs escalation.

  • Comfort working in a growing bank where processes and products continue to evolve, and the willingness to improve them as you go.

What makes a great ClearBank team member?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly about the best result for customers, colleagues and the bank.

  • You seek feedback, assume positive intent and build strong, trusting relationships.

  • You care about quality, but you also know that progress matters: you learn, iterate and improve.

  • 'I' before 'we' is not in your vocabulary. You succeed through clear ownership and collaboration

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you, combining working from our Amsterdam office with working from home.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus public holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the Netherlands for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – long term disability cover and accident cover.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Pension – We offer generous pension contribution without mandatory employee contribution.

  • Expense coverage – Mobile phone allowance and travel cost reimbursement.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future

You will provide authoritative challenge, anticipate emerging issues, lead complex remediation and recovery activity, and strengthen organisational capability while enabling sustainable growth.

 

Your role includes:

  • Provide independent second-line oversight and challenge across the design, approval, launch and ongoing management of lending products, ensuring material risks are understood, controlled and aligned with approved appetite.

  • Own the second-line review and challenge of complex or material credit proposals, portfolio strategies and periodic reviews, providing clear recommendations to senior decision-makers and governance committees.

  • Set the second-line approach to non-performing and vulnerable exposures, leading complex recovery strategies, senior stakeholder engagement, escalation and resolution to minimise losses and protect ClearBank's interests.

  • Shape and maintain the policy, appetite, control and governance framework across the credit lifecycle, partnering with model validation and other specialists to ensure credit risk and provisioning models remain robust and fit for purpose.

  • Provide senior oversight of financial risks, including asset and liability, liquidity and interest-rate risk, connecting risk assessments across disciplines and anticipating emerging balance-sheet vulnerabilities.

  • Lead complex, cross-functional risk initiatives with potential enterprise application, translating strategy and regulatory expectations into practical improvements across ClearBank Europe and the wider ClearBank Group.

What does success in this role look like:

You will:

  • Maintain a high-quality lending portfolio that enables sustainable growth within risk appetite.

  • Deliver forward-looking credit and financial risk insight that improves senior and committee decisions.

  • Resolve complex and emerging risks issues, including non-performing exposures, through decisive intervention, recovery and escalation.

  • Shape scalable policies, appetite, controls and governance for growth and regulatory change.

  • Act as a recognised expert and trusted adviser, influencing senior stakeholders through expertise, sound judgement and constructive challenge.

  • Align functions on competing priorities, ownership and enterprise risk outcomes.

  • Build capability through coaching, delegation and knowledge sharing.

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Extensive experience leading second-line challenge of complex credit risk in regulated financial services.

  • A track record of launching and scaling credit products within robust risk governance.

  • Advanced expertise in institutional lending, portfolios, problem exposures and risk drivers.

  • Strong knowledge of liquidity, interest-rate and asset-and-liability risk.

  • Ability to lead complex work independently and improve risk outcomes.

  • Exceptional analytical and communication skills, with credibility among senior stakeholders and committees.

  • Leadership experience in coaching, setting standards and creating accountability.

 

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank.

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care.

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate.

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary.

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

 

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you, combining working from our Amsterdam office with working from home.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus public holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the Netherlands for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – long term disability cover and accident cover.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Pension – We offer generous pension contribution without mandatory employee contribution.

  • Expense coverage – Mobile phone allowance and travel cost reimbursement.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

Role level: 5

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

title: Senior Account Manager - Warehouse Automation - BENELUX
description:
At Exotec, we design elegant, plug-and-play, and reliable end-to-end warehouse robotics solutions. As a leading Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Integrator, we support some of the world’s most iconic brands in their transition to automation. We’re proud to design technology that doesn’t just redefine intralogistics; it also makes warehouses safer, faster, more efficient, and less physically demanding for the people working inside them.

Why this role matters

Ready to move the world of intralogistics with tech? Join us as a Service Account Manager.

What You'll Do

We are looking for individuals who put customers first, take ownership of their work, execute with rigor, and simplify complex challenges. Successful team members demonstrate a continuous improvement mindset, collaborate effectively across functions, and contribute to collective success. At Exotec, we value people who are proactive, transparent, respectful, adaptable, and committed to delivering excellence while building long-term trust with both customers and colleagues.

  • Own the strategic relationship with a portfolio of customers, serving as their primary point of contact for service performance, escalations, and long-term success.
  • Lead regular business reviews and governance meetings with customers, ensuring transparency on KPIs, system performance, ongoing actions, and improvement plans.
  • Partner closely with Area Managers, Maintenance teams, Product, Performance Engineering, and Support functions to resolve customer concerns and drive operational excellence.
  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, translating customer feedback and business needs into actionable improvement initiatives.
  • Identify risks, challenges, and opportunities within customer accounts, coordinating proactive action plans to maintain customer satisfaction and contract performance.
  • Support customer growth by identifying upselling opportunities, service extensions, and additional value-added solutions aligned with customer needs.
  • Oversee the successful transition of customer sites from Deployment to Maintenance, ensuring a seamless handover and clear ownership model.
  • Monitor contractual performance, service levels, and commercial commitments while ensuring alignment between customer expectations and operational delivery.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance system reliability, service quality, and the overall customer experience.
  • Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders, from operational teams to senior leadership, acting as a long-term partner to their business.

Requirements

  • Experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, or Service Delivery.
  • Strong customer-facing skills and experience managing demanding stakeholders.
  • Ability to navigate complex organizations and coordinate cross-functional teams.
  • Commercial awareness with the ability to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Experience working in logistics, warehouse automation, intralogistics, manufacturing, industrial services, or a similar environment is highly valued.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
  • Fluent English required; additional languages are a plus.

Why you’ll love working here

  • Make an impact by building technology that improves business performance and people's everyday work. 
  • Grow faster by solving complex challenges in a fast-moving company where innovation, speed and ambition accelerate your development. 
  • Belong to a global team where diversity, inclusion and collaboration drive better decisions and stronger solutions. 
  • Connect beyond work by sharing passions, celebrating milestones and building lasting relationships that strengthen the way we work together.

title: Director, Global Operations Excellence
Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer. Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform.

Jouw rol

Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten.

  • Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting.

  • Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties.

  • Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden.

  • Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht.

  • Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform.

  • Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.  

  • Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project.


Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau. Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code. Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Je versterkt een snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met een sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met een directe en tastbare maatschappelijke impact.

  • Salaris: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €7.500,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om goed uit te rusten en op te laden.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een gezellige werksfeer op ons kantoor in Hilversum met flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor.

  • Mobiliteit & Fiets: Een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km of een volledige OV-vergoeding, én een fiscaal aantrekkelijk fietsplan.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen voor jouw toekomst.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor het volgen van opleidingen en trainingen om te blijven groeien, plus een jaarlijks Coolblue thuiswerkbudget van € 500,- om je werkplek perfect in te richten.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er toe doen. Denk aan de zorg, educatie, duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud. We bouwen software die logisch voelt. Precies dat maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis. We zoeken de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken elkaar. Benieuwd naar de sfeer bij Dawn Technology? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen Infrastructure Automation & Architecture) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Senior transformatieconsultant
description:
0,8 tot 1 fte | Utrecht | Hybride | € 5.086 - € 7.800 | Transformatie van organisaties | Wo

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Grote veranderingen vragen om meer dan een goed plan. Ze vragen om iemand die mensen, belangen en expertise samenbrengt en ervoor zorgt dat er daadwerkelijk beweging ontstaat.

Als senior transformatieconsultant begeleid je complexe en vaak meerjarige veranderprogramma’s bij grote organisaties. Je werkt op het snijvlak van strategie en uitvoering, verbindt experts vanuit verschillende vakgebieden en helpt opdrachtgevers om het transitieproces met succes te implementeren.

Omdat ons team groeit, krijg je veel ruimte om mee te bouwen aan onze propositie én aan je eigen ontwikkeling.

Dit ga je doen

Je stuurt complexe transformatieprogramma’s aan

Een transformatieconsultant begeleidt organisaties bij fundamentele veranderingen die verder gaan dan een gewone reorganisatie of procesverbetering. Het doel is om de organisatie duurzaam anders te laten functioneren, zodat zij beter kan inspelen op nieuwe strategische uitdagingen.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse regie op omvangrijke verandertrajecten bij opdrachtgevers. Vaak gaat het om programma’s die meerdere jaren lopen en waarbij meerdere organisatieonderdelen betrokken zijn. Je bewaakt de samenhang tussen strategie, organisatie-inrichting, processen & technologie, hr-processen, organisatiedynamiek en leiderschap. Je zorgt ervoor dat verandering niet alleen wordt bedacht maar ook daadwerkelijk wordt gerealiseerd.

Je verbindt mensen en expertise

De kracht van Berenschot zit in de combinatie van verschillende expertises. Afhankelijk van de opgave werk je samen met collega's op het gebied van organisatieontwikkeling, hr, leiderschap, cultuur, data-analyse, functiewaardering, bedrijfsvoering en collega’s uit specifieke sectoren. Denk daarbij aan openbaar bestuur, bedrijfsleven en energie & leefomgeving.

Jij brengt deze expertise samen rond één gezamenlijke ambitie. Je creëert structuur, houdt overzicht en zorgt ervoor dat mensen elkaar versterken en resultaten worden behaald.

Je bent een vertrouwde gesprekspartner voor bestuurders

Je werkt intensief samen met bestuurders, directeuren, programmateams en andere stakeholders. Je helpt hen keuzes te maken, creëert draagvlak en begeleidt besluitvorming in omgevingen waar verschillende belangen samenkomen.

Je durft richting te geven wanneer dat nodig is, maar begrijpt ook dat duurzame verandering begint met het meenemen van mensen.

Je bouwt mee aan de toekomst van het team Transformatie van organisaties

Naast je opdrachten draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze propositie. Je deelt kennis, ontwikkelt nieuwe aanpakken en begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s in hun professionele groei.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. 

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je komt te werken binnen de adviesgroep Transformaties van organisaties. Vanuit verschillende expertisegebieden werken we samen aan complexe veranderopgaven bij onze klanten. Vaak gebeurt dit onder regie van een transformatiepartner of programmamanager.

Wij geloven dat duurzame verandering alleen lukt wanneer strategie, organisatiestructuur, processen, systemen, hr, cultuur en leiderschap in samenhang worden aangepakt. Daarom werken we nadrukkelijk multidisciplinair en zoeken we collega’s die energie krijgen van het verbinden van mensen, ideeën en expertise.

Je werkt regelmatig zelfstandig bij de klant, maar bent nooit alleen. Achter je staat een sterk netwerk van collega’s dat je kunt inzetten wanneer een vraagstuk daarom vraagt. Juist die combinatie van zelfstandigheid, samenwerking en maatschappelijke impact maakt dit werk zo bijzonder.


Dit neem je mee

  • Een academisch werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal zes jaar ervaring met complexe verander-, transformatie- of reorganisatietrajecten, bijvoorbeeld als programmamanager, verandermanager of transformatieconsultant.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van omvangrijke programma’s binnen complexe organisaties en stakeholderomgevingen.

  • Het vermogen om verschillende expertises, belangen en mensen samen te brengen rond een gezamenlijke opgave.

  • Ondernemerschap en gevoel voor kansen in de markt. Je bouwt graag aan klantrelaties en duurzame samenwerkingen.

  • Verbindend leiderschap en een uitmuntend teamplayerschap. Je brengt rust, overzicht en vertrouwen, ook wanneer de omgeving dynamisch of politiek gevoelig is.

  • Nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om te ondernemen en de mogelijkheid om ons in te zetten voor belangrijke maatschappelijke thema’s. Kenmerkend is onze informele cultuur. Berenschot is een platte organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar echt naar je geluisterd wordt. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei, waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons diverse en inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.

Natuurlijk hebben we daarnaast ook uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en geweldige ontwikkelmogelijkheden:

  • een jaarcontract, met de absolute intentie om je na één jaar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd aan te bieden

  • een aantrekkelijk salaris tussen de € 5.086– en € 7.800,–, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring

  • een representatievergoeding van € 3.000,- per jaar

  • een reguliere collectieve winstdelingsregeling (afhankelijk van het resultaat van de onderneming)

  • een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling

  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bij een fulltime dienstverband maximaal 20 vakantiedagen bij te kopen

  • flexibele feestdagen. We bieden de mogelijkheid om officiële feestdagen te verschuiven naar dagen die voor jou van betekenis zijn.

  • een mobiliteitsregeling naar keuze: een auto van de zaak of een mobiliteitsbudget

  • een laptop en telefoon

  • de vrijheid om, in afstemming met je collega’s, te bepalen waar en wanneer je werkt

  • volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling via interne én externe opleidingen

Solliciteer meteen

Krijg jij energie van het begeleiden van complexe organisatieveranderingen? Vind je het leuk om mensen, expertise en belangen samen te brengen en langdurig samen te werken met klanten aan duurzame resultaten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Heb je vragen over de procedure? Neem contact op met Vicky Schats via ----- style="min-height: 1.7em;">

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Heb je gesolliciteerd? Dan ontvang je binnen één werkweek een reactie. Is die positief? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een kennismaking. Zijn we na dit gesprek allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een gesprek met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Dat is het moment om jouw laatste vragen te stellen.

Gaan die gesprekken goed? Dan vragen we je om een assessment te maken. Blijkt daaruit dat jij goed past bij Berenschot en onze manier van werken? Dan doen we je graag een passend aanbod.

Hierna ben je een echte Berenschotter en heten we je van harte welkom in ons team.

title: Account Director, Public Sector (DACH)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director, Public Sector (DACH) based in Netherlands.

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Director to lead public sector sales initiatives across the DACH region.
